candidates.name: Precision Management
candidates.description: At Precision Management, we empower our team to deliver exceptional property management through hands-on support, proven systems, and deep industry expertise, creating lasting value for our clients and enriching the communities we serve with integrity and purpose. We believe in leading with purpose and serving with precision—fostering a culture where employees and clients alike feel valued, supported, and driven to achieve excellence together. Our core values guide everything we do: 🔹 Empowerment 🔹 Motivation 🔹 Balance 🔹 Respect 🔹 Accountability 🔹 Collaboration 🔹 Excellence Let’s build stronger communities, one property at a time.
candidates.rationale: Both are U.S. multifamily property management companies serving apartment communities and owners, with similar resident/asset operations focus.

candidates.name: RHO Residential
candidates.description: RHO Residential is a property management company dedicated to setting new standards in multifamily operations. With specialized expertise in management, maintenance, due diligence, market analysis, repositioning, and strategic portfolio services, RHO delivers a holistic approach to property management. At the heart of our mission are our people—our dedicated team members who drive our success and foster a culture of collaboration, innovation, and care. We value their contributions, which are key to building positive relationships with owners, residents, and vendors, ensuring a smooth and rewarding experience for all. By enhancing communities and optimizing property performance, RHO Residential creates places that residents are proud to call home and brings lasting value to every partnership.
candidates.rationale: Both are multifamily property management firms serving apartment communities and institutional/ownership clients; same business model and buyer persona.

candidates.name: 2B Residential
candidates.description: *Formerly the Residential Division of Balke Brown Transwestern* 2B Residential is a full-service, award-winning, property management company, specializing in leasing multifamily and mixed-use properties. We know what it takes to create and manage market-leading, award-winning apartments. The kinds of places people are proud to live. The kinds of places that maintain value, year after year. That’s what we’ve been doing since 2012. We’re one of the most respected and fastest-growing property management companies in the Midwest, with market-leading properties in St. Louis, Southwest Illinois, Kansas City, Arkansas and Indiana. Our portfolio includes 10,000 of the region’s most sought-after residential units – with more added every month. Discover more about who we are and what we do by visiting our website today!
candidates.rationale: Same multifamily property management business, similar buyer persona, and comparable regional scale; likely a direct peer/lookalike.

candidates.name: Woodruff Property Management Company
candidates.description: The Woodruff Property Management Company specializes in third party management, Real Estate consulting, brokerage, development, asset management, marketing, and due diligence. For more than 45 years, the Woodruff Property Management Company has been successful in producing the highest occupancy rates, improving the quality of the property, and developing personal relationships with every client. We take great pride in what we do, going the extra mile for our owners and residents. There’s a reason we’re one of the top property management companies in the Southeast, with nearly 7,000 multifamily units in our fee management portfolio. Born and raised in the South, we understand what southern hospitality truly means. You will always enjoy a warm and friendly welcome to our communities. We are here to serve our residents and clients.
candidates.rationale: Both are multifamily property management firms serving apartment communities and institutional owners in the Southeast/Sunbelt.

candidates.name: Ascension Multifamily
candidates.description: Ascension is a value creation and property management firm focused on maximizing value of multifamily properties primarily in Texas. With over 100 years of combined experience in commercial real estate, the principals have vast knowledge and experience in various facets of the industry including over 50 real estate partnerships.
candidates.rationale: Both are multifamily property management firms serving apartment communities and institutional real estate owners in the Sunbelt/Texas.

candidates.name: Starka Property Management
candidates.description: Starka Properties Management offers a fresh and friendly approach to third-party property management. We pride ourselves on providing our clients with an unbiased assessment of their current assets and how to optimize their performance to maximize the return on their investment, all while adding white glove service to their tenants.
candidates.rationale: Both are multifamily property management firms serving apartment assets and owners, with similar third-party management and resident-service positioning.

candidates.name: Scully Company
candidates.description: Established seventy-five years ago, Scully Company brings generations of family know-how and professional experience. Scully Company specializes in multifamily real estate in both ownership and management capacities, managing communities consisting of large-scale garden, mid-rise, and high-rise apartment communities for institutions, private investors, and our own portfolio. Scully Company owns and manages properties in Florida, Pennsylvania, New Jersey, Massachusetts, and Connecticut. Operating in diverse locations with a keen focus on strategies specific to local markets, Scully Company has achieved recognition as a leader in the multifamily industry. Our top priority is to provide a truly unique residential experience. We provide quality living experiences, creating real resident value in communities people are proud to call home. Our commitment to excellence is the result of our time-tested standards. We invite you to experience the personal care and tried and true lifestyle provided by our family-run business.
candidates.rationale: Multifamily property owner-manager serving institutional investors, with similar apartment-operations model and resident-experience focus.

candidates.name: WRH Realty Services, Inc
candidates.description: WRH Realty Services (WRH) is one of the largest full-service property management firms in the southeast with properties in Florida, Texas, and North Carolina. Specializing in multifamily apartment homes, WRH manages a well-diversified portfolio of apartment communities comprised of over 11,000 units. We recognize that one of the keys to providing best in class service to our clients is the strength of the WRH Team. From our leasing specialists and maintenance teams to our property managers and accounting group, we constantly promote training, development and empowerment of each team member to utilize their talents and ideas to achieve established objectives. The WRH Team is comprised of over 350 focused and dedicated apartment professionals with local expertise, including over 40 corporate team members. We measure our success by the satisfaction of our residents and our clients, and we have the tools in place for each of our employees to achieve peak performance. Our WRH Team leverages its local expertise and training with a uniform technology platform across all properties to provide transparent metrics on operations, accounting, financial controls, training, marketing and compliance for clients. For more information, visit www.wrhrealty.com.
candidates.rationale: Same multifamily property management model, similar Sunbelt/Southeast footprint, comparable unit scale, and overlapping institutional-owner/resident focus.

candidates.name: Strategic Properties
candidates.description: Since its establishment in 2006, Strategic Properties (SP) has accumulated 17 years of expertise in property management and 12 years in centralization, with a primary focus on multifamily and single-family residences. Guided by the visionary leadership of co-founders Daniel Jaramillo and Tomas Sinisterra and strengthened by Ann-Marie Bomba's strategic partnership since 2023, SP prides itself on a collective six decades of multifamily experience. At the core of our mission is the commitment to enhance the lives of our stakeholders, beginning with the acquisition of exceptional talent. SP provides its employees with the necessary tools, support, and training fostering a culture of growth, passion, and positive impact. This commitment extends to our interactions with residents, properties, investors, and vendors, embodying the essence of our #BetterLife philosophy. Distinguishing itself in the industry, SP has a history of managing around 2300 units in Texas, Georgia, Missouri, and Florida driven by the 35 years of comprehensive real estate investment experience of our co-founders. Our strategic difference lies in the fusion of centralized support, advanced technology, and institutional boots on the ground operators ensuring the maximum potential of each of the communities managed by SP. OUR CORE VALUES - People-Centric Excellence - Empowerment through Centralizing - Commitment to Transparency - Traditional Values, Modern Approach
candidates.rationale: Same multifamily property management model, similar Sunbelt footprint, comparable institutional/residential customer base and operational focus.

candidates.name: Pmr Companies
candidates.description: Founded in May 2002 by industry veteran Deborah Charlton, CPM, PMR Companies LLC has quickly become a premiere, multi-regional property and asset management organization. Currently home to more than 250 industry professionals, many of our associates have specialized designations from the institute of Real Estate Management, The National Apartment Association, The National Association of Home Builders and various state and real estate commissions. Additionally our senior leadership has combined industry experience of more than 150 years. With our guiding philosophy of “Building Relationships”, PMR views each client, each customer and each vendor as a long term partner dependent upon trust and performance. With our hands-on style of value enhancement, PMR works to maximize returns of our clients, create a rewarding and enjoyable environment for our associates and provide the best possible customer service for our residents, commercial tenants and vendors PMR Companies is headquartered in Louisville, Kentucky.
candidates.rationale: Both are multifamily property and asset management firms serving apartment communities and institutional owners, with similar scale and buyer persona.
